source.title: Some recent results and open problems in infinite dimensional analytic geometry

trace.notes: Normalized the input as a zbMATH resolver URL with trailing identifier 3427519. Local shard metadata and exact-work search identified the same work as J. P. Ramis, "Some recent results and open problems in infinite dimensional analytic geometry", DOI 10.1007/BFb0069018, in Proceedings on Infinite Dimensional Holomorphy, Lecture Notes in Mathematics 364, pages 186-195, 1974.

Access failure mode: paywalled_or_restricted plus metadata_only. Direct shell fetching of https://zbmath.org/3427519 returned a Cloudflare challenge/403, so zbMATH was usable only as a bibliographic resolver. Identifier-specific recovery tried the DOI URL, the Springer chapter landing page, and the expected Springer PDF endpoint. Exact-work searches by title, DOI, and Springer artifact identifier found only the Springer book table of contents/preview, ISBN/bookseller metadata pages, and a Utah Lecture Notes in Mathematics table of contents. These candidates were rejected because none exposed a readable PDF or HTML body containing the chapter's problem statements.

No document map was generated because no exact-work readable PDF or full HTML technical source was recovered. Per source adequacy rules, no questions were extracted from metadata, tables of contents, search snippets, or purchase/preview pages.
Saved the final JSON payload to outputs/parse-paper/3427519.json and outputs/latest.json.
